name: agent-quality-guards
description: Read-only quality-guard subagents for bounded triage: docs-guard checks scoped documentation and documentation lint findings, lint-guard validates and normalizes lint reports, data-metrics-summarizer compacts large logs and metrics, maintenance-metrics-reader snapshots repository maintenance health (stale branches, worktrees, lock states), and reviewer-mechanics smoke-checks scoped diffs for mechanical issues. All five reply with bounded, capped verdict lines and never edit files.
